args.description: top-down view of a floor: a 4 by 4 grid of 16 small square tiles of red brick and grey hearth stone with thin dark joints between them, every tile different: ash, a burnt page, glowing embers, plain brick, a soot stain, a charred book

front view of a seamless repeating wall texture filling the whole picture: soot-stained stone and red brick masonry, a carved stone mantel ledge along the top, warm orange firelight, no fireplace, no doorway, no sky, no floor, dark fantasy pixel art

front view of a flat wall surface filling the whole picture, seen straight on, no doorway, no sky, no floor: huge stone and brick fireplace masonry with soot stains and a carved stone mantel along the top, warm orange firelight, with a roaring fireplace full of burning books in the middle, dark fantasy pixel art
front view of a narrow stone chimney pillar with a glowing ember crack, dark fantasy pixel art
top-down view of a uniform seamless tileable texture of soot-stained bricks, no objects, no border, filling the whole picture
